title: OB-GYN Hospitalist Fellowship
inst: University of Colorado Anschutz Medical Campus

title: Maternal Fetal Medicine Fellowship

title: Reproductive Endocrinology & Infertility Fellowship
Department: Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology, University of Michigan Medical School
Funding: Salary commensurate with a House Officer at an equivalent level of training (HOA contract)
Summary: The Michigan REI fellowship is a three-year program with 18 months of research and 18 months of clinical training, bringing together endocrinology and infertility specialists, reproductive urologists and research scientists.

title: Complex Benign Gynecology Fellowship

Summary: The University of Michigan Complex Benign Gynecology Fellowship is a two-year program, AAGL accredited since 2005, preparing gynecologic surgeons to become experts in complex gynecology and advanced laparoscopic and minimally invasive techniques.

title: Cancer Genetics & Breast Health Fellowship
Department: Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology, University of Michigan Medical School
Funding: Salary commensurate with a House Officer at an equivalent level of training (HOA contract)
Summary: A 1-year non-ACGME fellowship for OB/GYN residency graduates providing multidisciplinary training as an expert and consultant in breast and gynecologic cancer genetic mutations and breast health.

title: Global Women's Health Fellowship

Summary: A two-year program in which graduates of accredited OBGYN residency programs gain research and clinical skills for careers in global women's health, with 8-12 months in Ghana and Rwanda.

title: Pediatric & Adolescent Gynecology Fellowship
Department: Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology, University of Michigan Medical School

Summary: The Michigan Pediatric and Adolescent Gynecology fellowship is a two-year program in which trainees develop the gynecologic expertise to evaluate and treat patients from infancy and childhood through adolescence and young adulthood.

title: Obstetrics & Gynecology Hospitalist Fellowship
Department: Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology, University of Michigan Medical School
Funding: Salary commensurate with a House Officer at an equivalent level of training (HOA contract)
Summary: The Michigan OB/GYN Hospitalist Fellowship provides experience and mentorship for trainees to become leaders in inpatient OBGYN medicine, quality, safety and trainee education.

title: LGBTQ+ Reproductive & Sexual Health Fellowship
Department: Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology, University of Michigan Medical School
Funding: Salary commensurate with a House Officer at an equivalent level of training (HOA contract)
Summary: The LGBTQ+ Reproductive & Sexual Health Fellowship helps advanced trainees identify their paths as future leaders in LGBTQ+ health and provides resources for their individual success.

title: Women's Health Fellowship
Department: Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology, University of Michigan Medical School
Funding: Salary commensurate with a House Officer at an equivalent level of training (HOA contract)
Summary: The Michigan Women's Health Fellowship is a one-year clinically focused program providing trainees with a multidisciplinary experience to expand their expertise in women's health.

title: Maternal-Fetal Medicine Fellowship

Summary: The University of Utah MFM Fellowship offers customizable career tracks in advocacy, education, patient safety & quality improvement and clinical research, with clinical experience across two major health systems.

title: Reproductive Endocrinology and Infertility Fellowship

Summary: The University of Utah's three-year ACGME-accredited REI fellowship trains clinical experts in reproductive endocrinology and infertility for academic medicine, with a fully research-dedicated second year.

title: Pediatric and Adolescent Gynecology Fellowship

title: Maternal-Fetal Medicine Fellowship

title: Reproductive Endocrinology and Infertility Fellowship

title: Maternal-Fetal Medicine Fellowship

title: Reproductive Endocrinology and Infertility Fellowship

title: Maternal Fetal Medicine Fellowship at Mount Sinai West

title: Complex Benign Gynecology Fellowship
inst: The Mount Sinai Hospital (Icahn School of Medicine)

title: Reproductive Endocrinology and Infertility Fellowship

title: Maternal-Fetal Medicine Fellowship
